errors.text_span: 所有测试集中，“无”方法的WER值最高
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. In the 'Test3' group, the yellow bar for 'd-vector' (approx. 25%) is visibly higher than the light green bar for '无' (approx. 24.5%).
The WER for the '无' method is only above 25% for Test1 (approx. 26.5%) and Test2 (approx. 26%). For Test3, Test4, and Test5, the values are all below 25%.
This claim about relative ranking is incorrect. For example, in 'Test2', the 'i-vector' method has the lowest WER (approx. 22%) among all four methods.
The WER values for 'i-vector' range from approximately 20.5% (in Test5) to 24.5% (in Test1). The stated range of 23%-24% is too narrow and inaccurate.
This generalization is incorrect as it is only true for 2 out of the 5 test sets (Test1 and Test5). In Test2, Test3, and Test4, the WER for 'd-vector' is higher (worse) than for 'i-vector'.
This is an over-generalization. The 's-vector' method does not have the lowest WER in 'Test1' (d-vector is lower) or 'Test2' (i-vector is lower).
The WER for the 's-vector' method is only below 20% in one out of five cases (Test5, approx. 19.8%). All other values are above 20%.

errors.text_span: 引入向量特征提取方法（i-vector、d-vector、s-vector）相较于“无”方法显著降低了WER
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization and interpretation. The statement is factually incorrect because in Test3, the 'd-vector' method has a higher WER than the '无' method. Additionally, the word '显著' (significant) is an interpretation not explicitly supported by the chart's data.
